title: Your demo gym
intro: Everything here is fictional and private to you. Explore as staff or as a member, join as a new member with a test card, and check in at the kiosk.
introWithoutJoin: Everything here is fictional and private to you. Explore as staff or as a member and check in at the kiosk.
studentHelp: Open the member portal as Alex Student: two booked classes, a waitlist place, rank progress, a check-in QR code and paid invoices.
joinUnavailable: Joining online isn't available in this demo gym right now.
joinStepPlan: Open the join page, choose a plan and sign the waiver. Use any name and an email address you make up.
joinStepPay: Pay with this test card, any future expiry date and any CVC. No real money moves.
joinStepSignIn: Then sign in as your new member: they appear under Members who joined on this page and in the demo menu. You can also open the demo outbox as the owner and follow the sign-in link sent to the address you entered.
kioskHelp: In the member portal, open your check-in code. Then open the kiosk in another window of this browser, which is paired as the gym's kiosk, and scan the code with the camera, or check in by name and PIN.
joinedHelp: Sign in again as a member who joined this demo gym, newest first.
